summary: Wife, probably the second, of Gaetano di Marino and mother of Grazia; John's maternal 4th-great-grandmother.
bio: Caterina di Leo was the wife, probably the second wife, of Gaetano di Marino and the mother of his daughter Grazia. Gaetano's death record of 1876 describes him as the husband of Caterina di Leo, and Grazia's death record of 1916 names Caterina as her mother; some family records instead give Maria d'Ambrosio as Grazia's mother. Caterina had died by 1916. Her surname is that of Fr. Nunzio Di Leo, whose will funded the St. Rocco chapel at Guardia after the plague of 1656, though no link between them has been proven.
